name: itsuki
description: One private memory for every AI. Loads project memory when a session starts, saves decisions and fixes when it ends, and bundles the memory tools — with receipts for every write.

metadata.setup: Set ITSUKI_API_KEY in your shell profile (create one at https://itsuki.app → API keys), then restart your shell. That is the only step — the hooks and the in-session memory tools both use that one key.
